followUpGuide: For file creation, reserve a sentinel path state and still validate the full patch set before mutation.
For structured conflicts, return patch index plus reason such as `missing_file`, `stale_base`, or `overlap`.
For agent edits, store input file hash, patch hash, and resulting file hash so reviewers can audit exactly what changed.
complexityAnalysis: - Validation. Time: O(p log p + total checked slice length + total expected text length), where p is patch count; even a mismatched short expectation can cause a long text slice to be created. Extra space: O(p + largest checked slice).

- Application with repeated Python string slicing. Time: O(file count + sum over patches of current edited-file length and replacement length). Repeated copying can be quadratic as a file grows. Extra space includes O(file count + p) references, all retained changed-file outputs and the largest temporary edited string; unchanged file contents are shared, not copied.
- Applying from the right keeps offsets stable without rewriting patch coordinates.
solutionGuide: Group patches by file, validate ranges and expected text, reject overlaps, then apply from highest start offset to lowest.
